Take a look at the list of services we provide and see if there is anything we can help you with. If you have any further questions, please feel free to either call us or simply stop in. We will be happy to assist you. | Preventative Maintenance | Every automobile needs a repair expert at some point. Until then, providing your vehicle with routine preventative maintenance can help delay needing that expert. Feel free to stop by at any time and we can discuss what types of preventative maintenance you should be performing and how often to ensure you are obtaining the maximum performance from your vehicle and hopefully minimizing the need for repairs. | People have doctors to go when they don’t feel well. Your automobile deserves the same treatment. Through our well trained specialists, we will make sure that your vehicle gets the “5 star” treatment it deserves. We will provide you with preventative advice and/or diagnosis and treatment if necessary. As with your body, the more you do to take care of it, the better and longer it will perform. | Regular maintenance is very crucial to a vehicle. Too busy to be bothered? We handle everything from underneath the hood to the tires and even the the electronics of the interior. No job is too small for us. Drop on by and let us develop a plan that works for you and your schedule. | Oil Service | Routinely changing the oil and oil filter in your vehicle are crucial to the performance of your vehicle. The oil in your vehicle should be kept clean. Your engine oil and filter should be changed at intervals based on driving habits and type of oil your car requires. This will ensure maximum performance, and help keep your vehicle running longer. When we perform an oil/filter change, you can be assured we will use use top quality oil and top quality filters for each vehicle.Oil Service | Brake Service | Brakes are very essential for a vehicle. The rate at which they need to be changed varies on how the automobile is driven. We can inspect the entire braking system – from the pads, to the calipers, and brake lines for any wear or concerns. | Having the proper maintenance and/or making minor repairs can help you avoid larger repairs in the future. | Transmission Service | The transmission is another valuable part of your vehicle. We provide an “All Systems Check” transmission inspection. During this inspection we search for any unwanted leaks and malfunctioning parts. We even provide a complete transmission replacement as well. | Computer Diagnostics | Many parts of your vehicle are controlled by a computer. If you have a problem with something in the engine or another key part of the vehicle, the computer can tell you about it. We have the latest diagnostic equipment to identify which part of your engine or vehicle needs servicing. After careful review, we inform you on what the problem is, the procedures necessary, and the cost. | Air Conditioning | Your air conditioner provides comfort for you and your passengers on those hot and humid days. But what do you do when it stops working? Let Cupelli Automotive do a performance check to look for and repair any loose belts or leaks in your A/C unit before it stops working. | Fuel System | A dirty or clogged fuel system can cause poor acceleration and fuel economy. We inspect every detail from the fuel injectors to fuel lines, fuel pump and fuel filter. It doesn’t take much to get these elements clogged, so have them checked by Cupelli Automotive’s trained professionals before problems arise. | Cooling System | Your vehicle engine will get very hot if it runs for a period of time. Its the job of the cooling system to keep the engine from overheating. The cooling system pumps liquid coolant around the inner parts of the engine to keep it running at a safe temperature. We at Cupelli Automotive inspect every part of the cooling system. From the radiator parts to the rubber tubes that transport the coolant to / from the engine for leaks and cracks. We will make sure your engine is cooling properly with thorough testing. | Starter and Alternator | When you put the key in the ignition and start the car, it tells the starter motor to start the engine. If your starter motor is damaged you won’t be able to start your vehicle. The alternator, on the other hand, is responsible for keeping your car battery charged while the engine is running. If your alternator is damaged, your battery will drain and your vehicle will either not start or turn off.
